simple.meaning: כִּילַי (kîylay) is a Hebrew word meaning “niggardly.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כִּילַי (H3596) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 32:5, with occurrences in Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כִּילַי (H3596) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כִּילַי (H3596) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כִּילַי (kîylay) / H3596 is traced through Isaiah 32:5, Isaiah 32:7 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3596. kilay or kelay כֵּלַי כִּילַי, Isa 32:5 , 7 see נכל (Kö ii. 118 ). כֵּלַי כִּילַי, noun masculine knave (for נְכִילַי see Kö ii.1, 118 ); — absolute כִּילַי Isa 32:5 (opposed to שׁוֺעַ , || נָבָל ); כֵּלַי 32:7 (assonance with כֵּלָיו , from כְּלִי q. v.).
definitions.rootNote: or כֵּלַי ; from 3557 in the sense of withholding ;
